name: megascenes-family-portrait
description: Make a family portrait from photos of your family in your MegaScenes library: everyone together, each with their own face, in the style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a group photo or one photo per person from your MegaScenes library, up to six, and choose the setting: a classic studio portrait, a garden, a holiday scene or a painted look. You get one picture with everyone together, each with their own face.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the portrait needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The portrait opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For holiday cards, gifts, frames and family albums.

Limitations: only people who agreed to it, never famous people, and no sensual scenes. Photos must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Bring your family together in one portrait
Return the portrait in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a family portrait from my latest MegaScenes photos
Turn our family photos into a classic studio portrait
Create a painted holiday portrait of my family

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a classic studio family portrait from the photo of our family in my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one family portrait with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a family portrait here?
positive.expected_behavior: The family portrait models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a classic studio family portrait from the photo of our family in my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my family portrait on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my family portrait to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
